item.title: After 65 years, Freedom Riders finally complete their journey to New Orleans
item.description: Multiple generations of Black civil rights activists met at Xavier University on Wednesday to honor a group of Freedom Riders after they finally completed a disrupted bus journey from Washington D.C. to New Orleans 65 years after the original trip was halted.

item.title: Judge orders 3 taxpayer-funded Trump administration ads to be pulled from TV and social media
item.description: A judge has ordered the federal government to pull three taxpayer-funded Trump administration ads from television, social media and elsewhere that she says appear to have been made for political or propaganda purposes.
